name: hyper-text
title: Hyper Text
blurb: Text scrambles and reveals letter-by-letter on hover.
description: Splits text into characters that initially show random symbols from a charset, then resolve to the actual letters over the duration. Triggered by hover, viewport entry, or delay.
use_when: Hero or feature heading that needs an interactive reveal effect without changing layout.
avoid_when: Long-form text blocks — scrambling is distracting and slows reading.
a11y: Renders plain text markup but runs continuous RAF animation while animating. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
